attribution.note: Zitron's own words in his own newsletter post, stated as his view; not a quotation of someone else.

semantics.note: Unhedged 'will' about a definite amount by a stated deadline, so it is a scored forecast. 'Big tech' is reasonably tied to the four firms named just before. Dropping 'very little to show for it' is fine because it is a value judgment.

contract.note: The 2026-27 window and the use of total capex as a proxy are grounded in the preceding sentence and are fair. But the speaker gave no start date and said 'AI capex'. A cumulative window or an AI-only figure could change the result near the $2T threshold, so the interpretation may decide the outcome.

output.rationale: This is a forecast with an end-2027 deadline. The evaluation date is 2026-10-28, so it is not due. The packet has no evidence items, there is no early-resolution rule, and the 2026-27 capex figures are incomplete. It cannot be scored yet.
